adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` calling `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` synchronously when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true (lib/topic_retriever.rb). `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` invokes `TopicRetriever#retrieve` (app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb), so an embed miss can trigger a full feed fetch/parse (`SimpleRSS.parse open(...)`) and iteration over all `rss.items` importing each one (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb). This is a real performance/architecture concern introduced by the change, not a correctness bug per se.
